title: Lilith the Queen
summary: Lilith the Queen is a demonic Hecto-Titan who takes the form of an Egyptian queen. Her ten mummified legs and bat-like wings grant her speed both in the air and on the ground. She is the strongest Titan in the possession of Shauna.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Lilith the Queen was invoked by Shauna in [[Phoenix|Phoenix's]] volcano after [[Ash]] was defeated by being thrown into the lava by [[Baselaird]]. Lilith threw Baselaird on the ground, but she was knocked back by [[Lok Lambert]] using the [[Willblade]]. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}} Lilith again was invoked by Shauna at the [[Spiral Mark]] to fight against [[Powerbonded]] [[Caliban]]. Lilith ceased her attacks, as did Caliban, when [[Void]] was invoked.
{{source|The Spiral Mark}}

sections.wikitext:
Lilith is capable of fast flight, and her many legs offer her speed on the ground. She can use her long nails as weapons as well as make a long, javelin-like protrusion extend from her palm to be used as a weapon. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Lilith's summoning command is "'''Defy all'''".
* Lilith is based on the mythological [[wikipedia:Lilith|Lilith]], a demoness created before Eve who was a prior wife to Adam. According to this myth, she refused to accept Adam as head over her and left the Garden of Eden before Eve's creation. This Lilith may have had her origins in a demigoddess of Sumerian and Mesopotamian mythology.

full_text:
Lilith the Queen is a demonic Hecto-Titan who takes the form of an Egyptian queen. Her ten mummified legs and bat-like wings grant her speed both in the air and on the ground. She is the strongest Titan in the possession of Shauna.

History

Lilith the Queen was invoked by Shauna in Phoenix's volcano after Ash was defeated by being thrown into the lava by Baselaird. Lilith threw Baselaird on the ground, but she was knocked back by Lok Lambert using the Willblade. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Lilith again was invoked by Shauna at the Spiral Mark to fight against Powerbonded Caliban. Lilith ceased her attacks, as did Caliban, when Void was invoked.
[The Spiral Mark]

Abilities

Lilith is capable of fast flight, and her many legs offer her speed on the ground. She can use her long nails as weapons as well as make a long, javelin-like protrusion extend from her palm to be used as a weapon. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Gallery

Image caption: Lilith's Amulet

Image caption: Lilith's Icon

Image caption: Lilith

Trivia

• Lilith's summoning command is "Defy all".
• Lilith is based on the mythological Lilith, a demoness created before Eve who was a prior wife to Adam. According to this myth, she refused to accept Adam as head over her and left the Garden of Eden before Eve's creation. This Lilith may have had her origins in a demigoddess of Sumerian and Mesopotamian mythology.

International Names

French: Lilith la Reine
Portuguese: Rainha Lilith
